title: Mweya Wekutanga Kumira
intro: Kare kare mutumwa asati afamba panyika, rugwaro rusati rwazarurwa, chisikwa chisina kufanana nechimwe chakavapo. Mweya uyu wakaumbwa nemaoko aMwari, wakapihwa nzvimbo yerunako rusina muganho, uye wakaedzwa nenzira yaizodzokorora nhoroondo yese yevanhu. Zvakatevera nyaya yekushaya simba, kutendeuka kwechokwadi, uye mugumo waizochinja nzira yekusika nekusingaperi. Ungafungidzira here kuti uyu ndiani?
clues: Ndakaumbwa nemaoko eMune Ngoni Zvikuru kubva muguruva revhu chairo
Ndakapiwa musha une runako rusina muganho, uko nzara kana kuneta zvaisagona kundibata
Ndakarayirwa kuti ndisamboswedera pedyo nemuti mumwe chete, nekuti zvairambidzwa
Ini neshamwari yangu takanyengerwa tikaswedera pedyo nemuti wakarambidzwa, tichipesana nemurairo waShe wedu
Takadzokera kuna Ishe wedu nekutendeuka kwechokwadi, uye takaregererwa zvivi zvedu
Kubva kwatiri, vanhu vese vakabva; ndini wekutanga kufamba panyika ino

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
